name: von Willebrand disease 3
description: Type 3 von Willebrand disease (type 3 VWD) is the most severe form of VWD characterized by a bleeding disorder associated with a total or near-total absence of Willebrand factor (von Willebrand factor; VWF) in the plasma and cellular compartments, also leading to a profound deficiency of plasmatic factor VIII (FVIII).
